caption: The drawing is on a piece of yellowed, off-white paper and features precise, technical black ink lines forming an orthographic projection of a wooden chair, including a front view, side view, top view, and a detail view of a dowel. The chair has four vertical legs with turned shapes and decorative finials on top, connected by horizontal rungs, with five horizontal slats forming the backrest. Detailed dimensions are provided for heights, widths, and depths, including notations such as “43 1/2” for the total height, “20” for the front width, and “14 1/2” for the rear width. The top-down view shows a woven seat pattern secured to four posts. Above the side view is a cross-sectional detail of one slat labeled “3/8” bevel” and “3/4.”” There are additional notes on diameters and other measurements. A portion in the lower right corner displays two cylindrical dowels side by side, one with a rounded end and one squared, with the note “SCALE 1 1/2" = 1 FT.” The drawing is annotated with blue and black handwriting in some places and has a labeled code “NO. 76885-14.” The overall composition is highly structured, with straight and curved lines to represent the shapes and connections of chair parts, as well as notations and dimension lines that cross the page.
title: Armchair
